# Set-up
```{r}

cran_packages <- c("knitr", "readxl", "lme4", "ggeffects", "tidyverse", "here", "emmeans")

missing_cran <- setdiff(cran_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_cran)
}

require(knitr)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(ggeffects)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(emmeans)

inport_dir <- here("data")

# set default code chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F, message = F)

# set default plot theme
theme_set(theme_classic() +
            theme(text = element_text(size = 18)))

# suppress warnings about grouping
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = F)
```

# Data

```{r}

#Read in data
df.e3_childfc_raw <- read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e3_childfc.csv"), header = T,
                              na.strings = character(0))

```

Clean and Change Trial Names:

```{r}

# Clean data
df.e3_childfc = df.e3_childfc_raw %>%
  transmute(trial = Trial,
            order = PresentationOrder,
            faster = Faster,
            counterbalancing = Counterbalancing,
            gender = Gender,
            age = as.numeric(Age),
            school = Schoolig,
            condition = Category,
            id = id,
            correct = Harder_acc) %>%
  mutate(trial = factor(trial, levels=c("1","2","3","4","5","6","7","11","12","15"), labels=c("Number_TriCir","Number_Cross","Number_Vert","Number_Horz","Init_Horz","Init_Vert","TwoBlock_TenBlock","Pattern","Sampling","Vert_Horz"))) %>%
  mutate(condition = ifelse(trial== "Number_TriCir" | trial == "Number_Cross" | trial == "Number_Vert" | trial == "Number_Horz" | trial == "TwoBlock_TenBlock" | trial == "Vert_Horz", "Simple", "Complex")) %>%
    na.omit() %>% # there are two kids with no bday info
  mutate(ageBin = ifelse(age < median(age),"5-8","9-13"))


#renaming trials
df.e3_childfc <- df.e3_childfc |>
  mutate(trial = case_when(trial == "Number_TriCir" ~ "Number1",
                           trial == "Number_Cross" ~ "Number2",
                           trial == "Number_Vert" ~ "Number3",
                           trial == "Number_Horz" ~ "Number4",
                           trial == "Vert_Horz" ~ "Stability",
                           trial == "TwoBlock_TenBlock" ~ "Number&Stability",
                           trial == "Init_Horz" ~ "Process1",
                           trial == "Init_Vert" ~ "Process2",
                           trial == "Pattern" ~ "Pattern",
                           trial == "Sampling" ~ "Probability",
                           .default = trial))

```

# Process Cleaned Data

# Demographic Information

```{r}

df.e3_childfc |>
  select(id, gender, age, school, trial, correct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trial,
              values_from = correct) |>
  pull(age) |>
  mean()

df.e3_childfc |>
  select(id, gender, age, school, trial, correct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trial,
              values_from = correct) |>
  pull(age) |>
  sd()

df.e3_childfc |>
  select(id, gender, age, school, trial, correct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trial,
              values_from = correct) |>
  group_by(gender) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n())

```

Descriptives:

```{r}

df.e3_childfc |>
  distinct(id, age, school) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n(),
                   min_age = min(age), max_age = max(age),
                   mean_school = mean(school), sd_school = sd(school),
                   min_school = min(school), max_school = max(school))

# children dropped by na.omit() above (no age on record)
n_distinct(df.e3_childfc_raw$id) - n_distinct(df.e3_childfc$id)

```

# Analyses

```{r}

# Creating model here
model_e3_childfc <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + age + trial:age + (1|id),
                         family = "binomial",
                         control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                         optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)), data = df.e3_childfc)

model_e3_childfc |>
  summary()
```

Across age:

```{r}

ggemmeans(model = model_e3_childfc, terms = "trial")
ggemmeans(model = model_e3_childfc, terms = "age")

```

Age estimates:

```{r}

e3_age_range <- seq(5, 13, by = .01)

emm_options(rg.limit = 20000)

e3_age_analysis_raw <- ggemmeans(model = model_e3_childfc,
          terms = c("age [e3_age_range]", "trial"))

df.e3_age_analysis <- data.frame(age = e3_age_analysis_raw$x,
           trial = e3_age_analysis_raw$group,
           lowerCI = e3_age_analysis_raw$conf.low)

df.e3_age_analysis <- df.e3_age_analysis |>
  group_by(trial) |>
  mutate(passed = ifelse(any(lowerCI > 0.50), "passed", "did not pass .5")) |>
  ungroup()

df.e3_passed_min <- df.e3_age_analysis %>%
  filter(passed == "passed",
         lowerCI > .5) %>%
  group_by(trial) %>%
  summarise(min_age = min(age))

df.e3_no_pass <- df.e3_age_analysis |>
  filter(passed == "did not pass .5") |>
  group_by(trial) |>
  summarise(min_age = "did not pass .5")

df.e3_age_predictions <- rbind(df.e3_passed_min, df.e3_no_pass) |>
  mutate(min_age = as.numeric(min_age))

options(max.print = 10000)

print(df.e3_age_predictions)
```
